 Most recent Most popular FULL-TIME published at 19:41 GMT 19:41 GMT 
 AEK Athens 2-3 Real Madrid 
 Comeback complete and Real Madrid's winning streak goes on. Four wins from four in the Champions League this season.
 AEK Athens gave it a great go, but Federico Valverde's stunning goal from the edge of the box seals the win for the visitors.
 Aboubakary Koita, who scored the opener, is sent off after the final whistle for arguing with the referee.
 13 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 FULL-TIME published at 19:38 GMT 19:38 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 It's all over and Fenerbahce have twice come from behind to claim a famous win!
 Liverpool's sloppy defending costs them after they led, first through Trey Nyoni and then Alexander Isak. Their horrendous record in Turkey goes on.

 Post published at 90+3 mins 90+3 mins 
 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 That is surely it for Liverpool.
 Bradley Barcola finds Virgil van Dijk in space in the box but the defender skies the shot.

 GOAL - AEK Athens 2-3 Real Madrid published at 19:37 GMT 19:37 GMT 
 Federico Valverde (90+2 mins) 
 Heartbreak for AEK Athens.
 Real Madrid captain Federico Valverde surely seals all three points late in injury time as he flashes a strike across Alberto Brignoli and into the top right corner.

 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 Into three added minutes and now another error from Alisson!
 He comes out to deal with a clearance but ends up having to head it, can't find a red shirt and Matteo
Guendouzi goes for goal... drifts wide.

 We are being beaten by a very poor side. For all the possession and all the chances we are giving away early Xmas presents to the hosts. Awful defensive performance and Virgil has lost his leadership quality. Shocking.

 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 Into the last minute of the 90 and Fenerbahce have a throw-in in the Liverpool half.
 Not where Andoni Iraola's side want the game being played right now.

 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 Cody Gakpo finds space on the left and puts in a low cross but Alexander Isak can't divert in on target.
 Goal kick and time is running out for Liverpool.

 Post published at 87 mins 87 mins 
 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 The free-kick is hit well over the bar by Kerem Akturkoglu.
 Anyway, Ciaran, it's not been a great game for Alisson certainly but I'd argue he's looked much more like his old self - kicking aside - this season compared to last.

 SUBSTITUTION published at 85 mins 85 mins 
 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 A chance for the hosts to run the clock down a little as Bradley Barcola is adjudged to have fouled N'Golo Kante. The Liverpool man did not like that decision.
 Meanwhile, Lewis Koumas is sent on for Trey Nyoni just before Fenerbahce win a free-kick on the edge of the Liverpool box. Alexis Mac Allister is shown a yellow card.
 102 122 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 84 mins 84 mins 
 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 Cody Gakpo goes for goal from 25 yards but his shot flies harmlessly over.
 Fenerbahce will be happy if Liverpool are restricted to efforts like that between now and the final whistle.

 Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Brilliant header. When the ball comes in, I just think it's in the air for a very long time, and I'm looking at my goalkeeper and I'm thinking where is Alisson!?
 The goalkeeper has to come for that.

 Fenerbahce, as you'd expect, have dropped in now, trying to protect their lead.
 Liverpool come forward and a Virgil van Dijk header is saved by Ederson.
